concepts.title: What is ACE?
concepts.lead: Consciousness must evolve simultaneously across three dimensions: the kinds of decisions we make, the quality of our connections and the communities, and the ways we exchange.
agency.name: Agency
connection.name: Connection
exchange.name: Exchange
agency.heading: Making conscious decisions with PDAF pattern to maintain or change the current state.
connection.heading:
Neither Self-Centered nor Other-Centered.
Put the connection first.
connection.body: The connection determines where care, attention, and priority are needed at the moment.
exchange.heading: Currency is not the only way of exchange.
exchange.body: Gifts and commitments are equally important ways for humans to exchange with each other.
pdaf.title: The Decision Loop
preparation.name: Preparation
decision.name: Decision
action.name: Action
feedback.name: Feedback
preparation.body: Before deciding, notice your inner feelings and the signals around you. What is the situation, and what do you understand about it?
decision.body:
Make your decision based on one of these four phases of Agency.
Exploration. Stabilization. Expansion. Integration.
action.body:
Wait ten seconds, then act.
Sometimes, not acting is the best possible decision.
feedback.body:
Listen to your internal and external feedback that gives you information for your next round of Preparation.
Some feedback takes time to appear.
phases.title: Four Phases of Agency
exploration.name: Exploration
stabilization.name: Stabilization
expansion.name: Expansion
integration.name: Integration
exploration.body: Decisions for discovery and intuition, new possibilities, adventure, distraction, and finding solutions.
stabilization.body: Decisions to stabilize a situation and gain safety through regular repetition that builds skill.
expansion.body: Decisions to expand an existing skill, with creativity at their core.
integration.body: Decisions that connect an agent with others, creating interconnection and meaning.
phases.note: These phases are not a fixed sequence. Your situation shapes which ones you need.
